getStarted.title: Something to help you succeed
getStarted.description: Your first steps with CybeDefend Open Source: import results, run scans, connect your tools.

cloud.title: Skip the ops work: try CybeDefend Cloud free
cloud.body: Simpler and more complete: managed scanners, AI analysis that cuts false positives, AutoFix, and nothing to host.

privateCloud.title: Private cloud
privateCloud.body: A dedicated instance with full data isolation, your own custom domain and an SLA.

importSarif.title: Import your first SARIF results
importSarif.body: Open a project, then « Import results » on its results page.

kubernetes.title: Connect a Kubernetes cluster
kubernetes.body: Run the scanners on your own cluster instead of importing results.

ciImport.title: Import results from CI
ciImport.body: Send SARIF from any CI job to the import API with a personal access token.

githubAction.title: Use the GitHub Action
githubAction.body: Scan every push in GitHub Actions and import the results here.

repositories.title: Connect GitHub or GitLab
repositories.body: Link your repositories to create projects from them.

mcp.title: Use the MCP server
mcp.body: Connect your coding agent to this instance's MCP server and give it the findings.

policy.title: Create a security policy
policy.body: Set the rules your projects must meet, and see what breaks them.
